versions.subject: New File Access Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    FileName|endswith: '\Microsoft\Protect\CREDHIST'
filter_system_folders:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
        - 'C:\Windows\system32\'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
filter_processes:
    Image: 'C:\Windows\explorer.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: FileName="*\\Microsoft\\Protect\\CREDHIST" NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Program Files\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*", "C:\\Windows\\system32\\*", "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*") OR Image="C:\\Windows\\explorer.exe")
